name: pypto-user
description: Reusable PyPTO inspection and profiling workflows

interface.shortDescription: Inspect PyPTO IR and profile generated kernels.
interface.longDescription: User-facing PyPTO workflows shared across repositories for taking a new user from a fresh checkout to a validated run, generating interactive IR traces, collecting cycle-level in-core profiles, reconstructing the critical path of a chip-swimlane run, and auditing a task dependency graph for redundant edges.
interface.defaultPrompt: Inspect this PyPTO case and generate the appropriate trace.
